transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net home moving customer care, my name is Jason. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Jason, my name is Judith Holloway. I arranged a home move transfer for our broadband service three weeks ago, but when the moving van arrived at our new house today, the router was disconnected and an email arrived saying my move order had been cancelled without my knowledge!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Judith. I can inspect your moving order status and property asset records. Before we look at your account, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, our new address is 27 St Jude's Close, Salisbury, SP2 8BN, and my security PIN is 4491. My customer account number is SN-772109.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Judith, that confirms your account details. When was the installation date originally scheduled for?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It was booked for today between one o'clock and six o'clock, and the email claiming it was cancelled only arrived at eleven this morning because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I query our provisioning order workflow records on our order orchestration database in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Judith. The order workflow shows an automated cancellation trigger executed because our address validation department did not receive proof of tenancy for 27 St Jude's Close within fourteen calendar days so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I handed the signed tenancy agreement to your sales representative in your Salisbury retail store three weeks ago, and he scanned it right in front of me! Now my family is sitting in a house full of moving boxes with zero broadband, my husband cannot work remotely, and my children cannot do their schoolwork! I am absolutely furious and stressed out! Why did you cancel my order without even telephoning me because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Retail store documentation scans are subject to manual audit review by central provisioning compliance teams to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I do not care about central compliance audits, Jason! I need my broadband turned on today! Can you reinstate that order right now so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once a broadband provisioning order enters cancelled status in Openreach systems, it cannot be administratively reinstated in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then place a brand new emergency order for today since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Standard wholesale engineering lead times require a minimum of ten working days for fresh order fulfillment across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Ten working days?! We cannot live without internet for two weeks because of your retail store's incompetence! This is totally unacceptable! I demand to speak to your manager immediately because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Team managers do not have access to bypass national Openreach wholesale engineering lead times to ensure your S-Net service operates reliably without unexpected dropped packets or connection faults.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You cancelled our service without warning, took our money, and now refuse to let me speak to a supervisor! This is the most incompetent customer service I have ever witnessed so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously telecommunications provisioning workflows are governed by strict industry-wide wholesale regulations so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Stop reciting regulations at me and take responsibility for your company losing my tenancy documents since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am stating the procedural reality of wholesale telecommunications ordering to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are acting like a stupid customer if you expect an unverified broadband order to sit active indefinitely without compliance clearance to ensure your S-Net service operates reliably without unexpected dropped packets or connection faults.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Did you just call me stupid?! I am recording this telephone conversation! I will report you to the communications ombudsman and demand your immediate dismissal since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am stating the operational requirements of consumer contract verification so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Give me your employee ID number right now because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: My employee identification code is JS-9912.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: JS-9912, noted down. I will be submitting this entire recording to your chief executive officer today since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are entitled to submit formal written complaints via our corporate portal.

transcript.text: What is the order cancellation reference number?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A fresh order can be raised once you re-upload your tenancy agreement online.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will never give S-Net another penny of my money after this appalling abuse.

transcript.text: I have documented your complaint on customer ticket CMP-88192-J.
